question: Which Platinum clients missed their SLA settlement target last month?

runs.headline: All 8 Platinum clients fell short of settlement targets in September 2026, latest complete month.
runs.narrative: September 2026 (latest complete month in the data): all 8 Platinum clients missed their settlement-rate SLA, with rates ranging from 93.4% to 98.3% against targets of 99.0% or 98.5%. Eastgate Capital Partners missed hardest at 93.4%, 5.1 percentage points below its negotiated 98.5% target (CA-001 §2), instead of the standard 99.0% (POL-001 §2); the other 7 clients fell 0.7 to 2.1 percentage points short of 99.0%.
runs.sql:
SELECT c.client_name, c.sla_tier, d.year_num, d.month_num, COUNT(*) AS instructions, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.actual_settle_date_key = i.intended_settle_date_key) / COUNT(*), 2) AS settlement_rate_pct, 99.0 AS target_pct FROM harborline.stl_trade_instruction i JOIN harborline.dim_client c ON c.client_key = i.client_key JOIN harborline.dim_date d ON d.date_key = i.intended_settle_date_key WHERE c.sla_tier = 'PLATINUM' AND i.settlement_status IN ('SETTLED', 'FAILED') AND d.year_num = 2026 AND d.month_num = 9 GROUP BY c.client_name, c.sla_tier, d.year_num, d.month_num HAVING ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.actual_settle_date_key = i.intended_settle_date_key) / COUNT(*), 2) < 99.0 ORDER BY settlement_rate_pct ASC, c.client_name ASC
LIMIT 1000

dropped: Across the 8 clients, **11,211** settled instructions were processed in September; breaches trigger SLA credits of up to 5% of monthly custody fee per breached commitment, capped at 20% per client (POL-001 §3).

question: Which counterparties meet our tier-D criteria?

runs.headline: All **7 tier D counterparties** show fail rates of **12.3–13.6%** and average **6.5–7.4 days late**.
runs.narrative: All 7 counterparties assigned tier D exceed the 10.0% fail-rate threshold and the 4.0-day average lateness threshold (POL-007 §2), triggering mandatory pre-matching, daily fail reports, and client notification (POL-007 §4). Kendal Prowse Securities (12.43% fail rate, 9,375 instructions) and Hawick Dunn Securities (12.79%, 8,952 instructions) account for the largest settlement volumes; Kendal Prowse failed its first 90-day remediation review in July 2026 and faces recommendation to clients to use alternative counterparties if a second review fails (INC-2026-012 §3). Hawick Dunn Securities is under active incident review for sustained instruction-missing and mismatched-instruction fails post-migration (INC-2026-019 §1).
runs.sql:
WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(d.full_date) AS max_date FROM harborline.stl_trade_instruction i JOIN harborline.dim_date d ON d.date_key = i.intended_settle_date_key), perf AS (SELECT cp.counterparty_name, cp.reliability_tier AS assigned_tier, COUNT(*) AS instructions, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.settlement_status = 'FAILED') AS failed_instructions, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.settlement_status = 'FAILED') / COUNT(*), 2) AS fail_rate_pct, ROUND(AVG(i.days_failed) FILTER (WHERE i.settlement_status = 'FAILED'), 2) AS avg_days_failed FROM harborline.stl_trade_instruction i JOIN harborline.dim_counterparty cp ON cp.counterparty_key = i.counterparty_key JOIN harborline.dim_date d ON d.date_key = i.intended_settle_date_key CROSS JOIN latest l WHERE i.settlement_status IN ('SETTLED', 'FAILED') AND d.full_date > l.max_date - INTERVAL 12 MONTH AND (i.fail_reason_code IS NULL OR i.fail_reason_code <> 'MARKET_RESTRICTION') GROUP BY cp.counterparty_name, cp.reliability_tier) SELECT counterparty_name, assigned_tier, instructions, failed_instructions, fail_rate_pct, avg_days_failed FROM perf WHERE fail_rate_pct > 10 AND avg_days_failed > 4 ORDER BY fail_rate_pct DESC
LIMIT 1000

runs.headline: All 7 tier-D counterparties exceed 10% fail rate, averaging 12.8% failures over 12 months.
runs.narrative: All 7 counterparties assigned tier-D processed 37,358 instructions in the trailing 12 months, with fail rates spanning 12.3% to 13.6% and failed instructions resolved in 6.5 to 7.4 days on average. Tier-D assignment flags elevated operational risk; counterparties meeting both fail rate and resolution-time thresholds (>10% failures, >4 days to resolve) require monitoring or remediation discussions. Top 2 counterparties—Jedburgh Colt Securities (13.6% fail rate, 447 failures) and Lyndhurst Boyd Trust (13.2% fail rate, 533 failures)—account for 7,320 of 37,358 total instructions, concentrating risk exposure.
